_about: Golden regression set, tier 1: PLAN -> TABLE, no language model.
Each case is an analysis plan exactly as the planner would emit it, and the
numbers the engine must reproduce. Run: pytest tests/test_golden_plans.py
(needs the local DuckDB; skipped in CI). Re-record after an INTENTIONAL
method change with: python scripts/golden_record.py --update, and bump
METHOD_VERSION in explorer/version.py. Values verified against OECD
